subject.title: feat(hosting): add profile inspection and conformance tooling

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support the public `registerReadinessCriterion` Plugin SDK API, `gateway.readiness`/hosting-profile configuration, and the associated Gateway readiness contract that this final conformance layer consumes?
rationale: This PR cannot independently settle the compatibility and ownership of the unmerged prerequisite API stack. The prior review correctly identifies this as a product-contract decision rather than a mechanical follow-up.

options.title: Approve the readiness/profile contract
options.body: Accept the public API and operator-facing readiness/profile configuration, then review the dependent PRs in stack order before this conformance layer.

options.title: Narrow to core-only readiness
options.body: Land only a maintainer-defined core readiness surface and remove or defer the public plugin registration and hosting-profile layers.

options.title: Defer the feature stack
options.body: Pause the dependent PRs until maintainers choose a supported deployment/readiness product direction.

recommendation.title: Approve the readiness/profile contract
recommendation.body: Accept the public API and operator-facing readiness/profile configuration, then review the dependent PRs in stack order before this conformance layer.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the complete proposed stack and can supply design context, while final product acceptance must come from a repository maintainer outside the automated review.
